questions.text_english: Consider the following cases: (a) CaSO4 + Al (b) CuSO4 + Ca (c) FeSO4 + Cu (d) ZnSO4 + Mg. The cases in which new products will form are
questions.solution: Based on the reactivity series, a more reactive metal displaces a less reactive metal. Calcium displaces copper (b), and Magnesium displaces zinc (d). Hence, reactions will occur in cases b and d.

questions.solution_hindi: इस अभिक्रिया में SO2 से ऑक्सीजन का ह्रास हो रहा है (अपचयन), अतः यह उपचायक है। H2S से हाइड्रोजन का ह्रास हो रहा है (उपचयन), इसलिए यह अपचायक है।

questions.text_english: Consider the following statements about homologous series of carbon compounds: (a) All succeeding members differ by -CH2 unit. (b) Melting point and boiling point increases with increasing molecular mass. (c) The difference in molecular masses between two successive members is 16 u. (d) C2H2 and C3H4 are NOT the successive members of alkyne series. The correct statements are
questions.solution: Statements (a) and (b) are true for a homologous series. Statement (c) is false because the mass difference is 14 u, not 16 u. Statement (d) is false as C2H2 and C3H4 are successive alkynes.

questions.text_english: Which of the following statement(s) is (are) true about human heart? (a) Right atrium receives oxygenated blood from lungs through pulmonary artery. (b) Left atrium transfers oxygenated blood to left ventricle which sends it to various parts of the body. (c) Right atrium receives deoxygenated blood through vena cava from upper and lower body. questions.solution: The left atrium transfers oxygenated blood to the left ventricle, which pumps it to the body (b is true). The right atrium receives deoxygenated blood from the body via the vena cava (c is true).

options.A: पसलियाँ ऊपर उठी हुईं तथा डायाफ्राम वक्रीय/उभार लिए होता है।

questions.text_english: A cross made between two pea plants produces 50% tall and 50% short pea plants. The gene combination of the parental pea plants must be
questions.solution: A cross yielding a 1:1 ratio of dominant to recessive traits (50% tall, 50% short) occurs when a heterozygous plant (Tt) is crossed with a homozygous recessive plant (tt).

questions.text: पाँच सर्वसम प्रतिरोधकों के नेटवर्क का, जिसमें प्रत्येक प्रतिरोधक का प्रतिरोध 1/5 Ω है, अधिकतम प्रतिरोध कितना हो सकता है ?
questions.text_english: The maximum resistance of a network of five identical resistors of 1/5 Ω each can be
questions.solution: To get the maximum resistance, all the resistors must be connected in series. Max Resistance = R1 + R2 + R3 + R4 + R5 = 5 × (1/5 Ω) = 1 Ω.
questions.solution_hindi: अधिकतम प्रतिरोध प्राप्त करने के लिए सभी प्रतिरोधकों को श्रेणीक्रम में जोड़ना होता है। अधिकतम प्रतिरोध = 5 × (1/5) = 1 Ω.

questions.text: प्रतिरोध R1, R2 और R3 वाले तीन प्रतिरोधकों के I-V ग्राफ का अध्ययन करके निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प चुनिए :
questions.text_english: Study the I-V graph for three resistors of resistances R1, R2 and R3 and select the correct statement from the following:
questions.image_description: An I-V graph with Current (I) on the y-axis and Voltage (V) on the x-axis. Three straight lines from the origin represent resistors R1, R2, and R3. R1 has the steepest slope, R2 is in the middle, and R3 has the lowest slope.
questions.solution: In an I-V graph where I is on the y-axis and V is on the x-axis, the slope is 1/R. A steeper slope implies a lower resistance. Since R1 is the steepest, it has the lowest resistance. R3 has the lowest slope, so it has the highest resistance. Thus, R3 > R2 > R1.
questions.solution_hindi: I-V ग्राफ में (जहाँ I y-अक्ष पर है), ढलान = 1/R होता है। जिसका ढलान सबसे कम होगा, उसका प्रतिरोध सबसे अधिक होगा। यहाँ R3 का ढलान सबसे कम है, इसलिए इसका प्रतिरोध सबसे अधिक है। अतः R3 > R2 > R1 सही है।

questions.text: किसी धारावाही परिनालिका द्वारा उत्पन्न चुम्बकीय क्षेत्र की तीव्रता निम्नलिखित में से किस पर निर्भर नहीं करती है ?
questions.text_english: Strength of magnetic field produced by a current carrying solenoid DOES NOT depend upon :

options.B: परिनालिका से प्रवाहित धारा की दिशा

options_english.A: number of turns in the solenoid
options_english.B: direction of the current flowing through it
options_english.D: material of core of the solenoid

questions.solution: The strength of the magnetic field depends on the number of turns, the magnitude of the current, and the core material. The direction of current only changes the polarity (North/South poles) of the field, not its strength.
questions.solution_hindi: चुम्बकीय क्षेत्र की तीव्रता फेरों की संख्या, धारा के परिमाण और क्रोड के पदार्थ पर निर्भर करती है। धारा की दिशा केवल चुम्बकीय ध्रुवों को बदलती है, तीव्रता को नहीं।

questions.text: (a) “दो अभिकर्मकों के बीच यदि आयनों का आदान-प्रदान न हो तो कोई भी अवक्षेपण अभिक्रिया नहीं हो सकती है।” अभिक्रिया का संतुलित रासायनिक समीकरण देकर इस कथन की पुष्टि कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: (a) No precipitation reaction can occur without exchange of ions between the two reactants. Justify this statement giving a balanced chemical equation for the reaction.

key_points: Precipitation reactions inherently require the formation of an insoluble salt, which only happens when ions from two different soluble salts exchange partners.
Balanced equation example, such as BaCl2(aq) + Na2SO4(aq) → BaSO4(s) + 2NaCl(aq)

questions.solution: Precipitation reactions involve two aqueous ionic compounds reacting to form an insoluble solid (precipitate). This relies completely on the mutual exchange of ions to form the new insoluble compound. For example: Na2SO4(aq) + BaCl2(aq) → BaSO4(s) + 2NaCl(aq). Here, barium and sulfate ions exchange to form the white precipitate barium sulfate.
questions.solution_hindi: अवक्षेपण अभिक्रियाओं में दो जलीय आयनिक यौगिक मिलकर एक अघुलनशील ठोस (अवक्षेप) बनाते हैं। यह नए अघुलनशील यौगिक के निर्माण के लिए आयनों के पारस्परिक आदान-प्रदान पर निर्भर करता है। उदाहरण: Na2SO4(aq) + BaCl2(aq) → BaSO4(s) + 2NaCl(aq)। इसमें बेरियम और सल्फेट आयन मिलकर सफेद अवक्षेप बनाते हैं।

questions.text: (b) प्रत्येक का एक-एक उदाहरण देते हुए विस्थापन अभिक्रिया और द्वि-विस्थापन अभिक्रिया के बीच विभेदन कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: (b) Giving one example of each, differentiate between a displacement reaction and a double displacement reaction.

key_points: Displacement: A more reactive element displaces a less reactive element from its compound. Example: Zn + CuSO4 → ZnSO4 + Cu.
Double Displacement: Two compounds react by an exchange of ions to form two new compounds. Example: AgNO3 + NaCl → AgCl + NaNO3.

questions.solution: In a displacement reaction, a more reactive element displaces a less reactive one from its compound (e.g., Fe + CuSO4 → FeSO4 + Cu). In a double displacement reaction, two compounds exchange ions to form two new compounds, often forming a precipitate (e.g., AgNO3 + NaCl → AgCl + NaNO3).
questions.solution_hindi: विस्थापन अभिक्रिया में एक अधिक क्रियाशील तत्व कम क्रियाशील तत्व को उसके यौगिक से विस्थापित करता है (जैसे, Fe + CuSO4 → FeSO4 + Cu)। द्वि-विस्थापन में दो यौगिकों के बीच आयनों का आदान-प्रदान होकर नए यौगिक बनते हैं (जैसे, AgNO3 + NaCl → AgCl + NaNO3)।

questions.text: प्रकाश-संश्लेषण पत्तियों में होता है और इनके द्वारा बना भोजन पौधे के अन्य भागों में पहुँच जाता है । इसमें सम्मिलित प्रक्रिया का नाम लिखिए और उसकी व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Photosynthesis takes place in the leaves and the food prepared by it reaches other parts of the plants. Name the process involved and explain it.

key_points: Process is Translocation.
It involves the transport of soluble products of photosynthesis (like sucrose) through the vascular tissue called phloem.

questions.solution: The process is known as translocation. It is the transport of soluble products of photosynthesis, primarily sucrose, from the leaves to other parts of the plant through the vascular tissue called phloem. This process utilizes energy from ATP to move substances.
questions.solution_hindi: इस प्रक्रिया का नाम स्थानांतरण (Translocation) है। यह पत्तियों में बने प्रकाश-संश्लेषण के विलेय उत्पादों (मुख्यतः सुक्रोज) को फ्लोएम नामक संवहन ऊतक के माध्यम से पौधे के अन्य भागों तक पहुँचाने की प्रक्रिया है, जिसमें ATP ऊर्जा का उपयोग होता है।

questions.text: लैंगिक जनन के समय किसी स्पीशीज़ में DNA का स्थायित्व सुनिश्चित होता है। इस कथन की पुष्टि कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Stability of DNA in a species is ensured during sexual reproduction. Justify the statement.

key_points: During gamete formation (meiosis), the chromosome number is halved.
Upon fertilization, the fusion of male and female gametes restores the original diploid number of chromosomes.

questions.solution: During sexual reproduction, gametes are formed through meiosis, which halves the number of chromosomes and the DNA content. When male and female gametes fuse during fertilization, the original diploid number of chromosomes is restored, ensuring the stability of DNA across generations.
questions.solution_hindi: लैंगिक जनन में, युग्मक निर्माण (अर्धसूत्री विभाजन) के दौरान गुणसूत्रों और DNA की संख्या आधी हो जाती है। जब नर और मादा युग्मकों का संलयन होता है, तो गुणसूत्रों की मूल द्विगुणित संख्या पुनः स्थापित हो जाती है, जिससे प्रजाति में DNA का स्थायित्व बना रहता है।

questions.text: (a) प्रकाश के अपवर्तन के दो नियम लिखिए ।
questions.text_english: (a) State two laws of refraction of light.

key_points: First law: Incident ray, refracted ray, and normal at the point of incidence all lie in the same plane.
Second law (Snell's Law): The ratio of the sine of the angle of incidence to the sine of the angle of refraction is a constant for a given pair of media and color of light.

questions.solution: The two laws of refraction are: 1. The incident ray, the refracted ray, and the normal to the interface of two transparent media at the point of incidence, all lie in the same plane. 2. The ratio of the sine of the angle of incidence to the sine of the angle of refraction is constant (Snell's Law), i.e., sin i / sin r = constant.
questions.solution_hindi: अपवर्तन के दो नियम हैं: 1. आपतित किरण, अपवर्तित किरण तथा दोनों माध्यमों को पृथक करने वाले पृष्ठ के आपतन बिंदु पर अभिलंब सभी एक ही तल में होते हैं। 2. आपतन कोण की ज्या (sin i) तथा अपवर्तन कोण की ज्या (sin r) का अनुपात स्थिर होता है (स्नेल का नियम)।

questions.text: (b) किसी माध्यम के निरपेक्ष अपवर्तनांक की परिभाषा लिखिए । कोई प्रकाश किरण निर्वात से अपवर्तनांक 1.5 के काँच में प्रवेश करती है। काँच में प्रकाश की चाल ज्ञात कीजिए। निर्वात में प्रकाश की चाल 3×10⁸ m/s है।
questions.text_english: (b) Define the term absolute refractive index of a medium. A ray of light enters from vacuum to glass of absolute refractive index 1.5. Find the speed of light in glass. The speed of light in vacuum is 3×10⁸ m/s.

key_points: Absolute refractive index is the ratio of the speed of light in vacuum to the speed of light in the medium.
Formula: n = c / v. Calculation: v = 3×10⁸ / 1.5 = 2×10⁸ m/s.

questions.solution: Absolute refractive index is defined as the ratio of the speed of light in vacuum (c) to the speed of light in the given medium (v). Using the formula v = c / n, the speed of light in glass = (3 × 10⁸ m/s) / 1.5 = 2 × 10⁸ m/s.
questions.solution_hindi: निर्वात में प्रकाश की चाल तथा माध्यम में प्रकाश की चाल के अनुपात को माध्यम का निरपेक्ष अपवर्तनांक कहते हैं। सूत्र v = c / n का उपयोग करने पर, काँच में प्रकाश की चाल = (3 × 10⁸ m/s) / 1.5 = 2 × 10⁸ m/s होगी।

questions.text: ओम के नियम का उपयोग करके जब नीचे दिए गए आरेख के विद्युत परिपथ में कुंजी बन्द है, तब 3 Ω प्रतिरोधक के सिरों पर विभवान्तर निर्धारित कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Use Ohm's law to determine the potential difference across the 3 Ω resistor in the circuit shown in the following diagram when key is closed :

key_points: Total Resistance R = 1 + 2 + 3 = 6 Ohms.
Current I = V/R = 2 / 6 = 1/3 A.
Voltage across 3 Ohm resistor = I × 3 = (1/3) × 3 = 1 V.

questions.image_description: A circuit diagram containing a 2V battery, a closed key K, and three resistors in series with values 1 Ω, 2 Ω, and 3 Ω.
questions.solution: The resistors are in series. Total resistance R = 1 Ω + 2 Ω + 3 Ω = 6 Ω. Total current in the circuit I = V / R = 2V / 6 Ω = 1/3 A. The potential difference across the 3 Ω resistor is V_3 = I × R_3 = (1/3 A) × 3 Ω = 1 V.
questions.solution_hindi: परिपथ में प्रतिरोधक श्रेणीक्रम में हैं। कुल प्रतिरोध R = 1 Ω + 2 Ω + 3 Ω = 6 Ω। परिपथ में कुल धारा I = V / R = 2V / 6 Ω = 1/3 A। 3 Ω प्रतिरोधक के सिरों पर विभवांतर V_3 = I × R_3 = (1/3 A) × 3 Ω = 1 V।

questions.text: उन पदार्थों के लिए उपयोग होने वाले पद का नाम लिखिए जिनका विखण्डन जैविक प्रक्रियाओं द्वारा नहीं किया जा सकता है। उन दो तरीकों का उल्लेख कीजिए जिनसे वे किसी पारितंत्र के विभिन्न घटकों को हानि पहुँचाते हैं ।
questions.text_english: Name the term used for the materials which cannot be broken down by biological processes. Give two ways by which they harm various components of an ecosystem.

key_points: The term is 'Non-biodegradable' substances.
Harm 1: They persist in the environment, causing soil and water pollution.
Harm 2: They undergo biological magnification, accumulating in food chains and harming top predators.

questions.solution: Materials that cannot be broken down by biological processes are called 'non-biodegradable' substances. They harm the ecosystem in two ways: 1. They persist in the environment for a long time, leading to soil and water pollution. 2. Toxic non-biodegradable chemicals enter food chains and undergo biological magnification, harming organisms at higher trophic levels.
questions.solution_hindi: जिन पदार्थों का जैविक प्रक्रियाओं द्वारा अपघटन नहीं होता, उन्हें 'अजैव निम्नीकरणीय' (non-biodegradable) कहते हैं। वे दो प्रकार से हानि पहुँचाते हैं: 1. ये लंबे समय तक पर्यावरण में बने रहते हैं और मृदा व जल प्रदूषण फैलाते हैं। 2. विषैले रसायन खाद्य श्रृंखला में प्रवेश कर 'जैव आवर्धन' करते हैं, जिससे शीर्ष उपभोक्ताओं को हानि होती है।

questions.text: यह प्रेक्षण किया गया है कि कैल्सियम जल से अभिक्रिया करके उसके पृष्ठ पर तैरने लगता है । व्याख्या कीजिए ऐसा क्यों होता है। होने वाली अभिक्रिया का संतुलित रासायनिक समीकरण भी लिखिए । क्या होता है जब इस अभिक्रिया के उत्पाद के जलीय विलयन की कार्बन डाईऑक्साइड गैस से अभिक्रिया होती है ? अभिक्रिया का संतुलित रासायनिक समीकरण लिखिए ।
questions.text_english: It is observed that Calcium on reaction with water floats on its surface. Explain why it happens. Also write a balanced chemical equation for the reaction that occurs. What happens when the aqueous solution of the product of this reaction reacts with Carbon dioxide gas? Write a balanced chemical equation for the reaction.

key_points: Calcium floats because bubbles of hydrogen gas formed during the reaction stick to the surface of the metal.
Equation: Ca + 2H2O → Ca(OH)2 + H2
When product Ca(OH)2 reacts with CO2, it forms a white precipitate of Calcium Carbonate, turning limewater milky.
Equation: Ca(OH)2 + CO2 → CaCO3 + H2O

questions.solution: Calcium floats on water because the bubbles of hydrogen gas formed during the reaction stick to the surface of the metal, making it lighter. The balanced chemical equation is: Ca(s) + 2H2O(l) → Ca(OH)2(aq) + H2(g). When the aqueous solution of the product, calcium hydroxide (limewater), reacts with carbon dioxide, it forms an insoluble white precipitate of calcium carbonate, turning the solution milky. The balanced equation is: Ca(OH)2(aq) + CO2(g) → CaCO3(s) + H2O(l).

questions.text_english: Explain the events that take place once a sperm reaches the oviduct till it becomes a foetus. Write the role of placenta in pregnancy.

key_points: Fertilization: Sperm fuses with the egg in the oviduct to form a zygote.
Implantation: Zygote divides rapidly to form an embryo, which travels to the uterus and embeds in its thick lining.
Placenta role: It is a disc-like tissue that provides oxygen and nutrition from mother's blood to the growing embryo and removes waste materials from embryo to mother's blood.

questions.solution:
When a sperm reaches the oviduct, it fuses with the egg (fertilization) to form a zygote. The zygote repeatedly divides to form a ball of cells called an embryo. The embryo travels down and implants itself into the thick lining of the uterus, where it continues to grow into a foetus. 
Role of placenta: The placenta is a special disc-like tissue embedded in the uterine wall. It provides a large surface area for glucose and oxygen to pass from the mother's blood to the embryo, and it removes the waste substances generated by the embryo into the mother's blood.

questions.solution:
The power of accommodation is the ability of the human eye lens to adjust its focal length to clearly focus objects at varying distances on the retina. The ciliary muscles play the major role in this process. 
(i) Nearby objects: Ciliary muscles contract, causing the eye lens to become thicker. This decreases the focal length to focus the image clearly. 
(ii) Distant objects: Ciliary muscles relax, causing the eye lens to become thinner. This increases the focal length, enabling clear vision of distant objects.

questions.text_english: Use of pesticides to protect our crops affect organisms at various trophic levels especially human beings. Name the phenomenon involved and explain how does it happen.

key_points: The phenomenon is Biological Magnification (Biomagnification).
Pesticides are non-biodegradable chemicals.
They enter the food chain through producers (plants).
As they move up each trophic level, their concentration increases progressively, accumulating maximum in top predators like human beings.

questions.solution: The phenomenon involved is Biological Magnification. Pesticides are non-biodegradable chemicals sprayed on crops. These chemicals get washed into the soil or water bodies and are absorbed by plants (producers). When herbivores consume these plants, the chemicals enter their bodies. Since these chemicals cannot be broken down or excreted, their concentration increases progressively at each subsequent trophic level. Because human beings occupy the top level in most food chains, the maximum concentration of these harmful chemicals gets accumulated in human bodies.

sub_questions.text_english: Give reason why carbon can neither form C4+ cations nor C4- anions but form covalent compounds.

key_points: Forming C4- requires gaining 4 electrons, which is highly unstable because a nucleus with 6 protons cannot easily hold 10 electrons.
Forming C4+ requires losing 4 electrons, which demands a huge amount of energy to remove 4 electrons from the strong pull of the nucleus.
Thus, carbon shares electrons to complete its octet, forming covalent bonds.

sub_questions.solution: Carbon has 4 electrons in its outermost shell. Gaining 4 electrons to form a C4- anion is difficult because its nucleus with 6 protons would struggle to hold 10 electrons. Conversely, losing 4 electrons to form a C4+ cation requires an immense amount of energy, leaving behind a highly unstable nucleus holding only 2 electrons. Therefore, carbon achieves a stable noble gas configuration by sharing its valence electrons with other atoms, forming strong covalent bonds.

Use lens formula: 1/f = 1/v - 1/u
v = -10 cm. The image is formed 10 cm from the optical centre on the same side.

sub_questions.solution: Given for a concave lens: Object distance, u = -30 cm. Focal length, f = -15 cm. We must use the lens formula: 1/f = 1/v - 1/u. Rearranging for v, we get 1/v = 1/f + 1/u. Substituting the values: 1/v = (-1/15) + (-1/30). Finding a common denominator (30): 1/v = (-2/30) - (1/30) = -3/30. Thus, 1/v = -1/10, so v = -10 cm. The image is formed at a distance of 10 cm from the optical centre on the same side as the object.

sub_questions.solution: Salts having the same positive or negative radicals belong to a family. Sodium chloride (NaCl) and washing soda (Sodium carbonate, Na2CO3) both contain the common cation Sodium (Na+). Therefore, they both belong to the family of sodium salts.

sub_questions.text: pH स्केल की परिभाषा दीजिए। पोटैशियम हाइड्रॉक्साइड और सल्फ्युरिक अम्ल की अभिक्रिया से बनने वाले लवण का नाम तथा इस लवण के जलीय विलयन का pH मान लिखिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Define the term pH scale. Name the salt obtained by the reaction of Potassium hydroxide and Sulphuric acid and give the pH value of its aqueous solution.

key_points: pH scale is a scale for measuring hydrogen ion concentration in a solution.
Salt formed: Potassium sulphate (K2SO4).
pH value: 7 (since it's formed from a strong acid and a strong base).

sub_questions.solution: The pH scale is a measuring scale used to determine the hydrogen ion concentration in a solution to indicate its acidity or basicity. The reaction between Potassium hydroxide (a strong base) and Sulphuric acid (a strong acid) yields the salt Potassium sulphate (K2SO4). Since it is a neutral salt, its aqueous solution has a pH value of 7.

questions.text: अलैंगिक जनन द्वारा संतति उत्पन्न करने में एकल जनक भाग लेता है और इसमें युग्मनज नहीं बनते हैं। यह निम्नलिखित विधाओं द्वारा होता है विखण्डन, मुकुलन, खण्डन, बीजाणु समासंघ तथा पुनरुद्भवन (पुनर्जनन) । इनमें से पुनर्जनन जैसी विधा में प्लैनेरिया 'A' क्षैतिजतः तीन भागों में L, M और N कट गया है तथा प्लैनेरिया 'B' ऊर्ध्वाधरतः दो भागों O और P में कट गया है।
questions.text_english: Asexual reproduction involves a single parent to produce offsprings without the formation of gametes. It occurs by the following ways: Fission, Budding, Fragmentation, Spore formation and Regeneration. In one of the methods like regeneration, Planaria A is cut horizontally into three pieces L, M and N and Planaria B is cut vertically into two equal halves O and P.

sub_questions.text: इन दोनों प्लैनेरियाओं के कौन से भाग पुनरुद्भवन द्वारा विकसित होकर पूर्ण जीव का निर्माण कर लेंगे ?
sub_questions.text_english: Which of the cut pieces of the two Planaria could regenerate to form a complete organism?

key_points: All the cut pieces: L, M, N from Planaria A, and O, P from Planaria B will regenerate.

sub_questions.solution: All of the cut pieces—L, M, and N from Planaria A, and O and P from Planaria B—contain specialized cells capable of regenerating lost body parts to form complete organisms.

sub_questions.text: प्लैनेरिया की ही भाँति जनन की समान विधा को अपनाने वाले किसी अन्य जीव का उदाहरण दीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Give an example of another organism which follows the same mode of reproduction as Planaria.

key_points: Hydra

sub_questions.solution: Hydra is another organism that exhibits a high capacity for regeneration similar to Planaria.

sub_questions.text: पुनरुद्भवन में विकास का क्या अर्थ है ?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the meaning of 'development' in regeneration ?

key_points: It refers to the process where specialized cells proliferate and form a mass of cells.
From this mass, cells differentiate to form various cell types and tissues, following a sequence of changes to build the complete body structure.

sub_questions.solution: In regeneration, 'development' means the sequence of changes where specialized cells divide to form a large mass of cells. From this mass, cells undergo differentiation to form different cell types and tissues, ultimately rebuilding the complete, organized structure of the organism.

sub_questions.text: पुनरुद्भवन और खण्डन के बीच विभेदन कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Differentiate between regeneration and fragmentation.

key_points: Regeneration: An organism regrows lost body parts from specialized cells after an accidental cut or injury.
Fragmentation: A mature organism naturally breaks into smaller pieces upon maturation, and each piece grows into a new individual.

sub_questions.solution: Regeneration is an organism's ability to regrow lost body parts or form a whole new organism from a cut piece due to accidental injury, relying on specialized cells (e.g., Planaria). Fragmentation is a natural mode of asexual reproduction where a mature organism simply breaks up into smaller pieces upon maturation, and each piece grows into a new individual (e.g., Spirogyra).

questions.text: जब किसी विशुद्ध रूप से प्रतिरोधक परिपथ में विद्युत धारा प्रवाहित होती है, तो विद्युत ऊर्जा पूर्ण रूप से ऊष्मीय ऊर्जा में परिवर्तित हो जाती है। यह पाया गया है कि परिपथ में उत्पन्न ऊष्मा की मात्रा (H) (i) धारा के वर्ग (I2) के, (ii) चालक के प्रतिरोध (R) के तथा (iii) चालक में जितने समय तक धारा प्रवाहित होती है उस समय (t) के अनुक्रमानुपाती होती है। दूसरे शब्दों में, H=I2Rt । वैद्युत युक्तियाँ जैसे विद्युत फ्यूज़, विद्युत हीटर, विद्युत इस्तरी आदि, ये सभी विद्युत धारा के तापन प्रभाव पर आधारित हैं।
questions.text_english: When electric current flows in a purely resistive circuit electrical energy gets fully converted into heat energy. The amount of heat produced (H) in the circuit is found to be directly proportional to (i) the square of current (I2) (ii) the resistance (R) of the conductor and (iii) the time (t) for which current flows. In other words H=I2Rt. Electrical devices such an electric fuse, electric heater, electric iron etc. are all based on this effect called heating effect of electric current.

sub_questions.text: तापन अवयवों की दो विशेषताओं की सूची बनाइए ।
sub_questions.text_english: List two properties of heating elements.

key_points: High resistivity
High melting point (does not oxidize easily at high temperatures)

sub_questions.solution: Heating elements must possess high electrical resistivity to generate sufficient heat, and a high melting point so they do not melt or oxidize (burn) easily at high temperatures.

sub_questions.text: विद्युत फ्यूज़ की दो विशेषताओं की सूची बनाइए ।
sub_questions.text_english: List two properties of electric fuse.

key_points: Appropriate (relatively low) melting point.
High resistance.

sub_questions.solution: An electric fuse wire must have a relatively low melting point so it breaks when current exceeds a safe limit, and an appropriately high resistance to generate heat according to Joule's law.

sub_questions.text: उस नियम का नाम लिखिए जिस पर कोई विद्युत फ्यूज़ कार्य करता है। व्याख्या कीजिए कि विद्युत फ्यूज़ का तार किस प्रकार आकस्मिक उत्पन्न होने वाली उच्च विद्युत धारा से विद्युत साधित्रों को क्षतिग्रस्त होने से बचाने में सक्षम होता है।
sub_questions.text_english: Name the principle on which an electric fuse works. Explain how a fuse wire is capable of saving electrical appliances from getting damaged due to accidently produced high currents.

key_points: Principle: Heating effect of electric current (Joule's Law of Heating).
When an unexpectedly high current flows through the circuit, the high resistance fuse wire heats up rapidly.
Its low melting point causes it to melt, breaking the circuit and stopping the current, thus protecting the appliances.

sub_questions.solution: An electric fuse works on the principle of the 'Heating Effect of Electric Current' (Joule's Law of Heating). The fuse wire is placed in series with the appliance. When an accidentally high current flows through the circuit, the excessive heat generated rapidly raises the wire's temperature. Because it has a carefully chosen low melting point, the fuse wire melts, thereby breaking the circuit and stopping the flow of dangerous current to protect the appliance.

sub_questions.text: किसी विद्युत हीटर की शक्ति 1100 W है। यदि इस हीटर के दोनों सिरों के बीच विभवान्तर 220 V है, तो परिपथ से प्रवाहित धारा ज्ञात कीजिए। इस परिपथ में संयोजित 5A अनुमतांक के विद्युत फ्यूज़ का क्या होगा ?
sub_questions.text_english: The power of an electric heater is 1100 W. If the potential difference between the two terminals of the heater is 220 V, find the current flowing in the circuit. What will happen to an electric fuse of rating 5 A connected in this circuit?

key_points: Formula: P = V × I.
Current I = 1100 / 220 = 5 A.
The fuse operates at its exact limit. It may survive or melt after prolonged continuous use; ideally, a slightly higher rating fuse should be used, but functionally the 5A fuse might eventually blow.

sub_questions.solution: Using the power formula P = V × I, we can find the current I = P / V. So, I = 1100 W / 220 V = 5 A. The heater draws exactly 5 A of current. If an electric fuse of rating 5 A is connected, it will be operating exactly at its breaking threshold. Under continuous operation, fluctuations or prolonged heating might cause the fuse to melt and break the circuit. Generally, a fuse rating slightly higher than the device's operational current is recommended.
